about: The network models the page offers. Each entry names an .onnx file and its description (.json, as written by convert_to_onnx.py in the training code); board size, input planes, the rule set it was trained with and its search settings are read from the description. 'defaults' picks the model a new game of each rule set starts with; other rule sets of the same board size use the first model of that size.
